# Research brief: Asian Paints

## Recent Corporate Events

On 29 May 2026 the board approved the audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and year ended 31 March 2026 and recommended a final dividend for that period.  The same meeting set the 80th AGM for 9 July 2026 at 11:00 am IST via video conference or other audio-visual means (not confirmed in this run).  The AGM notice was published in newspapers on 9 June 2026 (not confirmed in this run).  An earlier board meeting on 27 January 2026 had approved results for the quarter and nine months ended 31 December 2025 (not confirmed in this run). [5]

## Fundamentals Valuation Snapshot

Asian Paints Ltd holds a market capitalization of ₹2,60,281 cr and ranks 35th among peers [14]. The share trades 1.85× more volatile than the Nifty [14]. Valuation indicators place the stock above market averages [14], while revenue and earnings growth trail broader benchmarks [14]. Profitability and efficiency ratios nevertheless register positively [14]. The share appears overpriced on entry metrics yet remains outside the overbought zone [14]. Data drawn from the latest available snapshots [11][12][14].

## Profitability Returns Metrics

No profitability returns metrics (such as ROE, ROCE, net margins or dividend yields) for Asian Paints are present in the supplied source. The extract dated 9 June 2026 contains only unrelated macroeconomic commentary on oil markets and Adani Ports. Not available in this run [7].

## Risks Catalysts Data Gaps

Risks include fallout from the West Asia crisis and Strait of Hormuz reopening, which may sustain oil-supply pressures and oversupply in related markets through mid-2026. [7]

Catalysts comprise the board-recommended final dividend for FY ended 31 March 2026 (approved 29 May 2026), audited FY2026 results released the same day, and the 80th AGM scheduled for 9 July 2026 (not confirmed in this run).  Q3FY26 results were issued 27 January 2026 (not confirmed in this run). [5]

Data gaps persist around granular segment or volume metrics; only announcement dates and earnings-call transcripts from 29 May 2026 are available as of 11 June 2026. [8][9]
